boundaries.name: \Gamma_o
boundaries.description: outer circle of the pipe casing, fixed boundary exchanging heat with the warm environment through a Robin condition with coefficient h and ambient temperature u_amb

boundaries.name: \Gamma_i
boundaries.description: inner circle (tube wall) held at the refrigerant temperature u_C; the constant-temperature condition is imposed as a penalty Robin condition with coefficient pen

constants.name: h
constants.description: effective convective heat transfer coefficient of the environment

constants.name: u_amb
constants.description: ambient temperature of the warm environment

constants.name: u_C
constants.description: refrigerant evaporating temperature imposed on the inner wall

constants.name: pen
constants.description: penalty coefficient implementing the constant-temperature condition on the inner boundary

constants.name: q_b
constants.description: casing temperature weight, q_b = h (u_amb - u_C) = 25 * 30

constants.name: R
constants.description: outer radius of the pipe cross-section

constants.name: r0
constants.description: initial inner radius of the design annulus

objective.name: J
objective.description: Minimizing J keeps the casing cold, i.e. it maximizes the heat absorbed from the environment through Gamma_o and delivered to the refrigerant; the outer-surface temperature integral is weighted by q_b and the material cost is weighted by the Lagrange multiplier ell.

state_equation.description: Linear diffusion (heat conduction) problem for the state u in P2(D) with weak-material conductivity k*chi and Robin-type conditions on the inner and outer circles.
state_equation.weak_form_lhs: \int_{D} k \chi \left( \nabla u \cdot \nabla \delta u \right) \,dx + \int_{\Gamma_i} \operatorname{pen} u \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} h u \delta u \,ds_x

adjoint_equation.description: Adjoint state \tilde u to the direct state u; the adjoint load comes from the partial derivative of the objective, \partial_u J(\delta u) = \int_{\Gamma_o} q_b \delta u \,ds_x.
adjoint_equation.weak_form_lhs: \int_{D} k \chi \left( \nabla \delta u \cdot \nabla \tilde u \right) \,dx + \int_{\Gamma_i} \operatorname{pen} \delta u \tilde u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} h \delta u \tilde u \,ds_x

boundaries.name: \Gamma_o
boundaries.description: outer circle of the pipe casing, fixed boundary exchanging heat with the warm environment through a Robin condition with coefficient h and ambient temperature u_amb

boundaries.name: \Gamma_i
boundaries.description: inner circle (tube wall) held at the refrigerant temperature u_C; the constant-temperature condition is imposed as a penalty Robin condition with coefficient pen

fields.name: u
fields.rationale: No Dirichlet boundaries are present; the constant-temperature condition on \Gamma_i is imposed weakly as a penalty Robin condition, so dirichlet_labels is empty.

constants.name: h
constants.description: effective convective heat transfer coefficient of the environment

constants.name: u_amb
constants.description: ambient temperature of the warm environment

constants.name: u_C
constants.description: refrigerant evaporating temperature imposed on the inner wall

constants.name: pen
constants.description: penalty coefficient implementing the constant-temperature condition on the inner boundary

constants.name: q_b
constants.description: casing temperature weight, q_b = h (u_amb - u_C) = 25 * 30

constants.name: R

constants.name: r0
constants.description: initial inner radius of the design annulus

expressions.name: k
expressions.rationale: The extracted state and adjoint weak forms use the symbol k; it is the solid thermal conductivity k_0 = 200 W/(m K). The weak void conductivity is obtained from the weak characteristic function value 1.3e-4, since k_0 * 1.3e-4 = 0.026 = k_air.

characteristic_function.rationale: Weak value chosen so that k_0 * chi_weak = k_air, regularising the void phase.

optimization_config.rationale: Designed from domain size R=0.5 m: hmin=0.005 (1/100 R), hmax=0.05 (1/10 R), diffusion=1e-4, v0=0.01, 30 iterations. Initial level set is positive in the design annulus r>r0, representing a fully solid aluminium casing; Gamma_i (label 2) is movable/design and Gamma_o (label 3) is fixed. The internal level-set boundary label 10 is design by default and is not listed in either boundary label list.
